title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Shop Supplies Fee Repaid on Maintenance Re-decisions
content:
**Rule.** For a maintenance re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the shop supplies fee repaid follows the labor on the repair order. The fee and the labor are read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.
- Where a shop supplies fee was charged, and every customer-pay labor charge on the repair order belongs to the repaired concern line, the whole fee is repaid.
- Where a shop supplies fee was charged, and the repair order also carries customer-pay labor on other concern lines, the fee is repaid in proportion. The proportion is the repaired line's labor charge over all customer-pay labor charged on the repair order, rounded half up to the cent.
- Otherwise none is repaid.

The repaired concern line is the one carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee.

**Input-judgement-output (hypothetical).**
- Fee 24.60; repaired line labor 525.00; all customer-pay labor 525.00. All labor is on the repaired line, so 24.60 is repaid.
- Fee 24.60; repaired line labor 525.00; all customer-pay labor 700.00. Labor is on other lines too, so the repayment is 24.60 times 525.00 over 700.00, which is 18.45.
- No fee charged: 0.00.
